title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Sam Darnold could return in Week 12
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald told Seattle Sports radio hosts Brock Huard and Mike Salk on Monday that the team is "really optimistic" QB Sam Darnold (quad) will get enough practice reps next week to start Nov. 29 against the 49ers, according to ESPN's Brady Henderson. Macdonald said Drew Lock has been great, "but Sam's our quarterback."
items.impact: Darnold has missed the last two games with a quad injury he suffered in Week 8 against the Bears, after also playing through a cracked rib. With Seattle on bye in Week 11, the extra week gives him more time to heal. Darnold could return as a QB2 against San Francisco if he practices fully next week. Lock remains a stash in superflex and 2QB leagues until Darnold's status is confirmed.

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Malik Willis' surgery decision still pending
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that no decision has been made on whether QB Malik Willis (groin/core) needs surgery.
items.impact: Miami placed Willis on injured reserve last week after an MRI showed his lingering groin issue had become a core muscle injury. He'll miss at least three more games. The team expected him back before the season ended, but potential surgery puts that return in doubt. He is only worth holding in deep superflex and 2QB leagues until there's an update. Kyle McCord remains Miami's starter.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cooper Rush signs with Tampa Bay practice squad
items.desc: Cooper Rush is signing with the Tampa Bay practice squad due to the injury to Baker Mayfield.
items.impact: With Mayfield dealing with a foot injury, the Bucs are bringing in Rush as extra depth. It's safe to assume Jalon Daniels would be the starter if Mayfield misses time, and Rush would be the backup in that situation.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DaRon Bland suffers ankle injury Sunday
items.desc: DaRon Bland left Sunday's game early against the 49ers with an ankle injury.
items.impact: The Cowboys are determining the extent of the injury for Bland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) day-to-day, to undergo more tests
items.desc: Brock Bowers is not believed to have suffered a major ankle injury.
items.impact: Bowers left Sunday's game early against the Seahawks. He will undergo more tests on Monday to determine the severity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zane Gonzalez waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived kicker Zane Gonzalez.
items.impact: Gonzalez missed two field goals in Sunday's two point loss against the Colts. They will seek another kicker this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Booker suffers high ankle sprain
items.desc: Cowboys OG suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Booker is expected to miss at least the next four weeks. Rapoport notes that Booker suffered a similar injury kept him out three games last season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Steelers D/ST dismal in loss Sunday
items.desc: The Steelers' D/ST logged one sack and allowed 38 points in Sunday's loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Pittsburgh's defense was terrible on Sunday night. They allowed 38 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log many big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should bounce back in a favorable matchup against the Eagles next week, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Boswell perfect in loss Sunday
items.desc: Chris Boswell made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Boswell did his job on Sunday, making both of his kicks to rack up a total of four points. He wasn't able to put up a good fantasy performance, however, just because the Steelers' offense wasn't able to get him into scoring range on many occasions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake Maye (ankle) out indefinitely
items.desc: The Patriots are concerned that QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle.
items.impact: Schefter notes that Maye remained in Germany to undergo additional testing to determine whether he needs surgery. He is feared to be out for the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Washington uninvolved in loss Sunday
items.desc: Darnell Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for five yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Washington didn't contribute much on Sunday. He caught just one pass for five yards over the course of the game, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He has week-to-week upside but won't be consistent moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Freiermuth finds end zone Sunday
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Freiermuth was a meaningful contributor for the Steelers on Sunday. He hauled in a touchdown on one of his two catches and racked up 35 yards in the process. He will continue to be fantasy relevant moving forward, although he's not immune from having bad games on a game-to-game basis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Germie Bernard held without catch in loss Sunday
items.desc: Germie Bernard didn't haul in any of his three targets in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: The rookie was locked down on Sunday night. He saw three targets over the course of the game but couldn't haul in any of them, leaving him with a goose egg in most categories on the stat sheet. He should not be started in any league formats for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle rushed the ball five times for 26 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Dowdle wasn't effective on Sunday, finishing with just 34 scoreless yards on seven total touches. He will continue to see involvement in this offense moving forward but shouldn't be regarded as much more than a handcuff fantasy asset behind Jaylen Warren for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DK Metcalf leads team in receiving Sunday
items.desc: DK Metcalf caught 2-of-6 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Metcalf ended the game with just two catches, but he was productive with them and was able to finish with 54 yards and a touchdown on the night. His fantasy total was decent in this matchup, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be consistent on a game-to-game basis over the back half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Warren underwhelming in loss Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren rushed the ball seven times for 15 yards and caught five passes for 26 yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Warren wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He finished with just 15 yards on the ground, but his involvement in the passing game was able to pad his fantasy total in PPR scoring formats. He should bounce back and return to being a high-end fantasy option sometime in the very near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Rodgers tosses two touchdowns in loss Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 15-of-29 passing attempts for 143 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: The Steelers weren't able to get it done on Sunday night, suffering a big loss at the hands of the Bengals. Rodgers had a decent performance in that game with two touchdowns and no turnovers, but he still made his fair share of mistakes and wasn't able to lead the offense to many points scored. Moving forward he should continue to be regarded as nothing more than a streaming option for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bengals D/ST plays well in win Sunday
items.desc: The Bengals' D/ST logged three sacks and allowed just 18 points in Sunday's win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Cincinnati's defense played great on Sunday night. They held the Steelers to just 18 points over the course of the game, though they weren't able to to log any turnovers in the process. This unit can be started in favorable matchups moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Evan McPherson scores seven points in win Sunday
items.desc: Evan McPherson went 5-for-5 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: McPherson scored seven points on Sunday night. He wasn't perfect, however, as he left three points on the field by missing one of his two field-goal attempts over the course of the game. He should continue to be a good fantasy option for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Drew Sample hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Drew Sample caught three passes for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Sample was able to contribute well with three catches on Sunday, one of which ended up going for a touchdown. Still, fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be a key part of this offense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dohnte Meyers scores once in win Sunday
items.desc: Dohnte Meyers caught two passes for 20 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Meyers didn't see a lot of work on Sunday, but he was still able to leave his mark on the game by catching a touchdown on one of his two receptions. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Samaje Perine finds end zone in win Sunday
items.desc: Samaje Perine rushed the ball six times for 14 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 25 yards through the air in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Perine had himself a nice game on Sunday. He wasn't very productive on the ground, but he was able to make up for that by getting into the end zone once and getting involved in the receiving game. He will continue to see meaningful touches for this offense moving forward, though he won't be a good fantasy option as long as he's behind Chase Brown in the pecking order.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Gesicki quiet in win Sunday
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Cincinnati's offense was unstoppable on Sunday night, but Gesicki wasn't able to get in on that. He finished with just one catch for nine yards, so he obviously had a disappointing fantasy total as well. He has decent streaming upside on a week-to-week basis but won't be consistent moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chase Brown scores twice in win Sunday
items.desc: Chase Brown rushed the ball 10 times for 44 yards and caught 8-of-9 targets for 39 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Brown finally had an explosive game on Sunday night. He racked up 83 total yards on the night and was able to get into the end zone twice through the air, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. This should give fantasy managers confidence that he will be a good option over the back half of the season, although he still seems prone to some bad performances on a week-to-week basis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tee Higgins solid in win Sunday
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-6 targets for 66 yards in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Cincinnati's offense was unstoppable in Sunday night's big win over the Steelers. Higgins wasn't able to fully take advantage of that, however, finishing with five catches for 66 yards over the course of the game. He will have some more less than impressive games moving forward, but his boom weeks have been frequent enough to make him a stellar starting option over the first half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase racks up whopping 231 yards Sunday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase hauled in 11-of-14 targets for a whopping 231 yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Chase was unstoppable on Sunday night. He racked up a whopping 231 receiving yards on 11 catches, which left him with a dominant fantasy total despite the fact that he didn't get into the end zone at all. He is heating up right now after a slightly slow start to the season and is primed to be one of the best players in fantasy over the back half of the year.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Burrow dominant in win Sunday
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 35-of-44 passing attempts for 409 yards and four touchdowns in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Burrow had another unreal performance on Sunday night. He took on a tough Pittsburgh defense, but he was able to come away with over 400 yards and four touchdowns en route to a win, while also committing zero turnovers in the process. He has been playing some of the best football in the league recently and will certainly be an MVP finalist if he can continue on a similar pace over the back half of the season.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Hunter Luepke sees two touches in Week 10
items.desc: Hunter Luepke rushed once for nine yards while also catching his only target for six yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Luepke has seen minimal involvement in the Dallas offense to this point, recording three touches or less in all 10 contests. The fullback can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brevyn Spann-Ford quiet in Week 10
items.desc: Brevyn Spann-Ford hauled in one of his three targets for 26 yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Spann-Ford has made minimal impact in the Dallas passing attack to this point, finishing with 35 receiving yards or less in all 10 games. The tight end remains difficult to trust in any format ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Israel Abanikanda sees three touches in Week 10
items.desc: Israel Abanikanda rushed twice for eight yards while also catching his only target for two yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Abanikanda made minimal impact in his first game of the season, recording 3.33 yards per touch in the loss. The running back can remain off rosters despite an elevated role as the backup to RB1 Javonte Williams entering a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: KaVontae Turpin logs two touches in Week 10
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin rushed once for nine yards while also catching on of his three targets for 10 yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Turpin has made minimal impact on offense when healthy, finishing with less than 20 offensive yards on four of five contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats entering a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Luke Schoonmaker sees two targets in Week 10
items.desc: Luke Schoonmaker caught one of his two targets for 12 yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Schoonmaker has been a non-factor in the Dallas offense to this point, recording one or less receptions in all eight of his games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cowboys D/ST dismal in Week 10
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST registered five sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: The defense had no answers for an efficient 49ers offense, allowing three rushing and passing touchdowns along with a franchise-record 584 offensive yards in the loss. The unit remains difficult to roster in any format despite a more favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) out for season
items.desc: Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) is out for the rest of the season for the Detroit Lions according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Hutchinson suffered the season-ending injury while landing awkwardly after celebrating his first-quarter sack of New England quarterback Drake Maye. The defensive end's loss is a significant blow to a Detroit front seven reliant on the star pass-rusher's dynamic ability to pressure opposing quarterbacks ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Raiders D/ST recovers two fumbles Sunday
items.desc: The Raiders D/ST allowed 21 points on 382 total yards with three sacks and two fumble recoveries on Sunday.
items.impact: The Raiders allowed just seven points in the first half before getting burned badly by Jaxon Smith-Njigba in the third quarter. They will have Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Gay connects on three kicks Sunday
items.desc: Matt Gay went 2-for-2 on field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Gay made field goals from 34 and 43 yards out. He also made his lone extra point attempt.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Mayer catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught 2-of-3 targets for 16 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Mayer could be a streaming option moving forward if Brock Bowers (ankle) is set to miss time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Bech sees seven targets Sunday
items.desc: Jack Bech caught 2-of-7 targets for 10 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: It did not result in much production, but Bech led the Raiders in targets in the first start for Fernando Mendoza. If Brock Bowers misses time, Bech could be worth a look on waivers in deeper leagues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre Tucker catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Tre Tucker caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Tucker struggled in a tough matchup and with Fernando Mendoza making his first career start. It is unclear what his role will be moving forward with Mendoza now starting the rest of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. shut down Sunday
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. ran for 23 yards on eight carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught his lone target for four yards receiving.
items.impact: Washington saw eight carries to Ashton Jeanty's nine carries on a day where they were both once again shut down on the ground. He remains a volatile flex play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Jeanty totals 64 yards from scrimmage Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty ran for 18 yards on nine carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 46 yards receiving.
items.impact: Jeanty was once again shut down on the ground. The majority of his yardage on the day came on a catch and run for 38 yards. He remains a borderline RB2 play for fantasy managers right now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Mendoza runs for touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Fernando Mendoza completed 17-of-29 passes for 143 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Mendoza had some success early in his first career start, including a rushing touchdown on his first possession. He lost Brock Bowers to an injury early which didn't help. Mendoza did not turn the ball over, but he was sacked six times. He draws another tough matchup next week against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seahawks D/ST dominates in second half Sunday
items.desc: The Seahawks defense allowed 13 points on 163 total yards with six sacks on Sunday.
items.impact: Fernando Mendoza had some success early in his first career start, but the Seahawks locked in against him by the second half. They will be facing the 49ers in Week 12 out of their bye.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Myers misses field goal Sunday
items.desc: Jason Myers went 0-for-1 on field goal attempts and 3-for-3 on extra point attempts.
items.impact: Myers missed a field goal from 44 yards out. He is still 16-of-18 on the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner hauls in three passes Sunday
items.desc: AJ Barner caught 3-of-3 targets for 19 yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Barner remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton not targeted Sunday
items.desc: Tory Horton was not targeted in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: While he was not targeted, Horton had an impressive play on special teams as he batted a kickoff in bounds to help take the clock under the two minute warning. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-2 targets for eight yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Shaheed was making his way back from injured reserve. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp hauled in his lone target for a 34-yard touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Kupp got open in the end zone with Drew Lock stopping just in front of the line scrimmage and finding him for a sliding catch. Kupp remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba explodes in third quarter Sunday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 8-of-10 targsts for 171 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba entered halftime with just 11 yards before exploding for a huge third quarter that included a 71-yard touchdown reception plus other gains of 30 and 23 yards. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Jadarian Price ran for 36 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders. He also caught his lone target for eight yards receiving.
items.impact: Price was able to score a touchdown for the first time in his career. He continues to look like the 1B in the backfield for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet as the 1A. Price remains a steady flex option.
